rules.quote: Always use capitals for the title of the current Australian monarch.

rules.quote: Capitalise ‘Governor-General’ when it’s part of the formal title

rules.why: Heading explicitly establishes the capitalisation rule for the formal title.

covers.quote: When you are referring to 2 or more people who hold or have held the title, use lower case and refer to them as ‘governors-general’.

rules.quote: When you are referring to the generic term, use lower case ‘governor-general’.
rules.violation_condition: 'governor-general' or plural 'governors-general' capitalised when used generically
when: When referring to the generic term or to 2 or more people who hold or have held the title.
rules.why: G-2: Pairs with the formal capitalisation rule by establishing the lower-case generic usage.

Conclude with ‘Yours faithfully’.
